primary_hypothesis: With identical hybrid delta+attention topology, data, objective, batches and parameter count, bidirectional attention inside the fully observed prompt while answer generation stays causal improves free-generated reasoning versus fully causal prompt processing.
architecture: 2 persistent gated-delta + 2 attention blocks; only prompt-attention visibility differs
selection: fixed step800 only; no held checkpoint selection
semantic_split: canonical arithmetic ignores op/order; list ignores order/kind; mutable memory stores per-key ordered histories; train/validation/held disjoint
no_oracle: model receives prompt token IDs and prefix lengths only; gold remains outside inference
scope: small mechanism probe; not a 300-800M result and not Qwen parity
